user.title: ESB Smart Meter
user.description: Enter your ESB Networks account credentials and MPRN. Home Assistant will log in once to check them.

data_description.mprn: 11-digit Meter Point Reference Number from your ESB Networks account

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter ESB Networks credentials
reauth_confirm.description: ESB Networks rejected the saved login. Enter your current email address and password.

error.invalid_auth: ESB Networks rejected that email address or password.
error.rate_limited: ESB Networks is asking for human verification (too many recent logins). Wait 24 hours and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not log in to ESB Networks. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

data_description.update_interval: How often to download data. ESB publishes new readings about once a day; a saved login is reused between updates, so this rarely causes extra logins.

update_failed.title: ESB Smart Meter data is not updating
update_failed.description:
Downloading data from ESB Networks has been failing. Last error: {error}. Last successful update: {last_success}.

If ESB is asking for human verification, the integration waits 24 hours between login attempts. This warning clears on the next successful update.
